--- /opt/clore-hosting/hosting/pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "clore-hosting"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "CLORE.AI hosting agent"
requires-python = "==3.13.*"

dependencies = [
    "docker~=7.1",
    "aiofiles>=24.1,<26",
    "aiohttp~=3.13",
    "pydantic~=2.13",
    "speedtest-cli==2.1.3",
    "psutil~=7.2",
    "websockets>=15,<17",
    "packaging>=24.2,<27",
    "nvidia-ml-py>=12.560,<14",
    "requests~=2.34",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff>=0.15.14,<0.16",
    "pyright>=1.1.400",
    "pre-commit>=4.6",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py313"
line-length = 120

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B", "UP"]
